name: Shin Taketori Monogatari
source:
The game is a gag parody on Japanese Taketori legend. The purpose of the game is to discover anything at any opportunity and have fun. 

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作是对日本《竹取物语》传说的恶搞改编。游戏的目标就是抓住一切机会探索新奇事物，尽情享受乐趣。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
